title: GestureEvent
description: Spatial hand gesture event emitted by the vision microservice or camera nodes.

node_id.description: Unique identifier of the emitting node (e.g. pi-projector, mac-host, desk-node)

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds when gesture was recognized

coordinates.description: Normalized (0.0 to 1.0) or projected spatial coordinates of the primary hand landmark

confidence.description: Model confidence score for the detected gesture
